hypothesis: W-R22's perfect mask-aware performance relied on missing data never obscuring the reordered observations and on applying occlusion before ordering. Mask AFTER the order perturbation; isolate untouched, irrelevant, one-sided, and fully erased swap observations to quantify identifiability limits.
freeze: Original first use only, exact unchanged previously trained W-R22 models and original source. No retraining on withheld mask geometries, no post-result case exclusion or threshold changes.
training: Import W-R22 train(arm) exactly, 16 development seeds 240..255, 1728 pairs/model, 32 epochs, width 16. No rerun of W-R22 heldout seeds.

heldout.mask_application: Generate original and observation; generate clean positive and clean negatively reordered candidates first; apply identical absolute-tick row mask afterward to BOTH. A complete two-row swap erasure produces observationally identical pos/neg, which is not a label-predictable outcome.

primary: Report per-generator/swap/mask case observed-identical pair fraction, TP/TN/FP/FN and accuracy for all models. Fully-erased pairs have a theoretical paired balanced-accuracy upper bound 0.5, not 1.0. IDENTIFIABILITY_BOUNDARY if all fully-erased pairs are observationally identical, no other cases are identical, and maskaware_clean reaches at least 0.8 accuracy in every identifiable cell. PARTIAL_BOUNDARY if observational-equivalence controls hold but identifiable-cell threshold fails; INVALID otherwise.
controls: Verify heldout examples use seeds 272..287 only
No changed training weights or additional model parameters
Do not count identical paired positive/negative examples as correct/incorrect after selecting one label: retain BOTH and report irreducible maximum accuracy
Missing sentinel (0,0,0,0) used only from observed four channels; no hidden mask identity supplied to the classifier
Exact blob identities, first-use archived evidence, one full Go test/build regression
claim_limit: Synthetic observation identifiability only; no generalized temporal understanding or natural language claim.
